info.name: Looker Studio Create a linked report

params.name: c.reportId
params.description: The template report ID. If omitted, a blank report is used as the template.

params.name: c.pageId
params.description: The page ID to display when the report loads. If omitted, the first page is shown.

params.name: c.mode
params.description: The initial mode for the report. Use 'view' for view mode or 'edit' for edit mode.

params.name: c.explain
params.description: When set to true, enables a debug dialog that shows how the Linking API parameters are being interpreted.

params.name: r.reportName
params.description: Sets the name for the new report.

params.name: r.measurementId
params.description: Configures Google Analytics measurement IDs for the report.

params.name: r.keepMeasurementId
params.description: When set to true, preserves the template report's measurement IDs.

params.name: ds.ds0.connector
params.description: Specifies the connector type for data source ds0. When set, the template data source configuration is completely replaced and all required connector parameters must be specified. Supported connectors include bigQuery, cloudSpanner, communityConnector, googleAnalytics, googleCloudStorage, googleSheets, looker, and searchConsole.

params.name: ds.ds0.datasourceName
params.description: Sets a custom name for data source ds0.

params.name: ds.ds0.refreshFields
params.description: When set to true, refreshes the field definitions for data source ds0 after configuration.

params.name: ds.ds0.projectId
params.description: The Google Cloud project ID for data source ds0. Used with BigQuery, Cloud Spanner, and Google Cloud Storage connectors.

params.name: ds.ds0.datasetId
params.description: The BigQuery dataset ID for data source ds0. Used with the BigQuery connector.

params.name: ds.ds0.tableId
params.description: The BigQuery table ID for data source ds0. Used with the BigQuery TABLE connector type.

params.name: ds.ds0.type
params.description: The BigQuery query type. Use TABLE for standard table access or CUSTOM_QUERY for SQL queries.

params.name: ds.ds0.sql
params.description: The SQL query for BigQuery CUSTOM_QUERY type data sources.

params.name: ds.ds0.spreadsheetId
params.description: The Google Sheets spreadsheet ID for data source ds0.

params.name: ds.ds0.worksheetId
params.description: The worksheet ID within a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

params.name: ds.ds0.hasHeader
params.description: Whether the Google Sheets data source has a header row.

params.name: ds.ds0.includeHiddenCells
params.description: Whether to include hidden and filtered cells from Google Sheets.

params.name: ds.ds0.accountId
params.description: The Google Analytics account ID for data source ds0.

params.name: ds.ds0.propertyId
params.description: The Google Analytics property ID for data source ds0.

params.name: ds.ds0.viewId
params.description: The Google Analytics view ID for data source ds0.

items.docs: Creates a dynamic URL that directs users to a pre-configured Looker Studio report. The URL can specify a template report, configure data sources, set the initial mode (view or edit), and customize report behavior. Users who follow the link see the pre-configured report and can click "Edit and share" to save a personal copy.
